apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.7

Fixed an Android 9 compatibility issue that could incorrectly report "The APK has an unexpected signing certificate" for a valid download. MES Store now requests the certificate information Android 9 requires while preserving all certificate, checksum, package, and version checks.

If an older MES Store cannot install this update because of that message, download this official APK in a browser and install it over the existing MES Store. Do not uninstall the app. The package ID and release signing key are unchanged.

Includes the offline header status, inline tutorial illustrations, full-screen image viewing, remaining reading time, and interface improvements from 1.2.6. App installation still requires Android confirmation.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.1

Back from the driver step restores the shipper's handwriting for review or correction. Includes the inspection and loading workflow and signed BOL printing integration.

Install over the existing SignPad app to keep pairing and authorization. MES authorization is required to access company data.

apps.name: Time Punch
apps.description: Employee PIN, punch photos, and clock-in, break, and clock-out actions for MES tablets.
apps.releaseNotes:
Time Punch 1.0.0

A dedicated MES timecard punch app for Android tablets.

Enter an existing six-digit employee PIN, look at the camera, and choose Clock In, Start Break, End Break, or Clock Out. Available actions follow the current MES timecard. Clocking out on a break closes that break first.

Includes camera punch photos, automatic screen reset, English/Spanish/Chinese/Japanese employee action screens, encrypted station configuration, and durable recovery of interrupted punches with duplicate-safe retries.

Requires Android 9 or later, a camera, connectivity to MES, and one-time setup with the MES station access code. The production server address is prefilled. Employee PINs are not saved on the device. Keep the app open if a punch is awaiting confirmation.
